title: Director Budget Investment
description:
Click on "Learn more about this agency" button below for IMPORTANT additional information.

The primary purpose of this position is to exercise overall staff responsibility for planning, establishing policy for, directing and administering Air Force-wide budget activities across a variety of Air Force appropriations and funds.

Duties

Plans, directs and supervises the budget formulation efforts of the Air Force in the above appropriations, and in this capacity serve as the Air Force Budget Investment focal point. Develops definitive and detailed estimates of financing requirements of numerous program alternatives and combinations of alternatives utilizes in the formulation of the final approved Air Force program. This involves the development of two separate and distinct but compatible budget estimates, i.e., the Air Force budget expressed in appropriation terms and a budget arrayed in the Future Years Defense Program (FYDP) format of the Planning, Programming, Budgeting System (PPBS). Plans and directs the development of definitive estimates for an extended period for the individual weapon and support systems that comprise Program Elements across the FYDP. The Director provides continuous improvement of the financial management systems to insure maximum utilization of available resources and to facilitate the relating of capital investments and other costs to weapon systems, tasks and missions. Plans, directs, and supervises the development of data to aid in the proper assessment of cost and effectiveness of alternate programs. This permits the Department of the Air Force and the Department of Defense management to make crucial decisions as to the major forces and weapon systems required to accomplish the Air Force mission. Plans, directs and coordinates the activities of the Directorate in ensuring effective utilization of available resources and correlating investment costs to procured weapon systems, MILCON, MFH, BRAC, and FMs; evaluating budget execution performance and identifying key programmatic and funding issues; participating with the Air Staff in formulation of composite policies and objectives in achieving the best balance between dollar availability among multi-year appropriations and scope of program; assuring consistency of policies between the diversified appropriation and budget activities; developing data to aid in the assessment of cost and effectiveness of alternate programs. Plans, directs and coordinates the activities of the Directorate in the Air Force's Enhanced Corporate Structure to achieve and maintain the proper balance between program levels and available financing. Incumbent will serve as Chairperson of the Investment Budget Review Committee (IBRC), which conducts an in-depth analysis of all investment programs. Presents recommendations to the Air Force Board to best realign investment resources and defend those resources based on the IBRC analysis of budget execution and/or program executability. Plans, directs and supervises the preparation and submission of authorization requests and budget estimates to the Office, Secretary of Defense (OSD), Office of Management and Budget (0MB), Armed Services and Appropriations Committees of the Congress; the preparation of justification material for support of these annual authorizations and budget estimates; and the preparation of material for inclusion of the President's Annual Budget Message to Congress. Plans, directs, supervises and coordinates the presentation and defense of authorization and directs and supervises the execution of the budget in such a manner as to improve the stature and standards of the Air Force through the effective expenditure of these multi-billion dollar appropriations. Directs and supervises the review of the USAF policies and objectives pertaining to the various appropriations to assure consistency and conformance to the Air Force objectives, and to achieve and maintain the proper balance between program level and available financing. Establishes broad guidance and supervises the development of apportionment requests and backup material in defense thereof to obtain release of funds appropriated by Congress, and for the defense of these requests before OSD and 0MB. The Director supervises the control and distribution of appropriated and apportioned funds to appropriate commands, operating agencies, and PEO's and the administration of these appropriations to insure conformance with legal requirements. Directs continuing efforts to improve the accuracy and creditability of estimates and the management of all resources; directs a continuing evaluation of the use and relationship of resources required for various program elements in terms of need and time. This involves field visits, meetings and conferences with the major operating commands and other agencies, as well as advising and guiding Air Staff efforts along these lines. Directs and supervises financial management of Security Assistance Activities (SAA) which includes policy and procedures, budgeting, International Cooperative Programs and Non-recurring Cost Recoupment.

Requirements

  • U.S. citizenship is required
  • Males must be registered for Selective Service, see
  • Disclosure of Political Appointments
  • Mobility is a condition of employment and appointment for SES members will be required to sign a Reassignment Rights and Obligations Agreement
  • Selected candidate must file an Executive Personnel Financial Disclosure Report (OGE Form 278) in accordance with the Ethics in Government Act of 1978
  • Position has been designated Critical-Sensitive and the selectee must have or be able to obtain a Top Secret clearance
  • Drug testing designated position. The incumbent is subject to random testing for drug use IAW Exec. Order 12564, dated 14 Sep 86. Position requires that the incumbent sign a Drug Testing letter and pass urinalysis testing prior to appointment.
  • Position requires travel under conditions specified in the DoD Joint Travel Regulations. Incumbent is expected to travel on short notice to attend high-level meetings.
  • Position may require incumbent to be available for other than normal duty hours to include weekends to support exercises and crisis planning.
  • An initial SES career appointment becomes final only after the individual successfully completes a 1-year probationary period.
  • Attendance to the Air Force's Senior Leader Orientation Course (SLOC) is generally required within 12 months of appointment, subject to course availability.
  • Position may be subject to the post-government employment restrictions of Sections 207(a) and (f) of Title 18, United States Code.
  • Applicants in receipt of an annuity based on civilian employment in the Federal Service are subject to the DoD Policy on The Employment of Annuitants.

Descrição do cargo

Gerente Administrativo & Operacional na Solverh. Faixa salarial: R$5.536,00 por mês. Salário real baseado em competências e experiência; falar com o recrutador para saber mais.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS

  • Conduzir equipes administrativas e operacionais com o objetivo de assegurar o efetivo completo de mão de obra nos contratos sob sua gestão.
  • Planejar, organizar e monitorar o ciclo completo de gestão de pessoas: recrutamento, seleção, admissão, acompanhamento, desligamento e movimentações internas.
  • Apoiar a célula administrativa nas tratativas diárias que envolvem colaboradores, garantindo o cumprimento das rotinas de ponto, folha e obrigações trabalhistas.
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre a empresa e o cliente, compreendendo suas demandas e oferecendo soluções rápidas e eficazes (convocação de horas, uniformes, substituições e comportamento).
  • Conduzir processos de mobilização e desmobilização de contratos, incluindo abertura de filiais/unidades de apoio, contratação e treinamento de equipes, bem como encerramentos contratuais.

  • Promover a qualidade dos serviços, a busca por resultados e a melhoria contínua, elaborando e implementando soluções para otimização operacional.
  • Monitorar, estimular e desenvolver a performance das equipes sob sua responsabilidade.
  • Atuar junto à Diretoria na análise de indicadores, resultados e planos de ação.

ATIVIDADES PERIÓDICAS

  • Diárias — Acompanhar rotinas administrativas (ponto, admissões, demissões, afastamentos e tratativas de folha).
  • Manter contato direto com clientes por telefone e e-mail para tratar demandas contratuais e operacionais.
  • Garantir substituições imediatas e correções em efetivo de pessoal.
  • Semanais — Reuniões de alinhamento com a célula administrativa e unidades de apoio.
  • Supervisão das demandas de EPI e uniformes.
  • Acompanhamento de indicadores de presença e produtividade.
  • Mensais — Reuniões com clientes e diretoria.
  • Auditoria de folha de pagamento e contratos de fornecedores.
  • Análise de turnover e absenteísmo.
  • Anuais — Participar de planejamentos estratégicos e ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Revisão de procedimentos operacionais e indicadores da área.

REQUISITOS DO CARGO

  • Escolaridade : Ensino superior completo em Administração, Logística, Gestão de Pessoas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência : Mínimo de 5 anos em cargos de gestão operacional ou administrativa.
  • Conhecimentos Necessários : Gestão de contratos e equipes distribuídas geograficamente; Rotinas trabalhistas e de folha de pagamento; Pacote Office intermediário.
  • Requisitos Complementares : Disponibilidade total para viagens e flexibilidade de horário.

COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS

  • Planejamento e organização operacional.
  • Gestão de indicadores e relatórios de performance.
  • Processos de recrutamento, admissão e desligamento.
  • Gestão de fornecedores e controle de contratos.
  • Conhecimento em legislação trabalhista e normas de segurança.

CONDIÇÕES DE TRABALHO

  • Trabalho majoritariamente administrativo, com visitas operacionais e viagens frequentes.
  • Exposição a ambientes de operação logística e administrativos.
  • Uso de telefone corporativo e notebook.
  • Eventual necessidade de atendimento a demandas fora do horário comercial.

BENEFÍCIOS

ADICIONAIS

title: Senior Director Continuous Improvement, Learning & Enablement
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a dynamic and innovative Senior Director, Continuous Improvement Organizational Learning, to lead the transformation of our enterprise learning and enablement ecosystem for continuous improvement. This role will be responsible for designing and executing a modern learning strategy that empowers associates, strengthens leadership capabilities, and drives measurable business outcomes across the organization built on our Regal Rexnord Business System (RBS).

As a senior leader within the Regal Rexnord Business System (RBS) enterprise team, you will lead the modernization and scaling of training programs aligned with Regal Rexnord’s Continuous Improvement (CI) principles and leadership competencies. This includes optimizing content, enhancing learning platforms, and ensuring consistent deployment across global teams. The ideal candidate brings deep Lean/CI expertise, a passion for learning innovation, and a proven ability to drive measurable business outcomes through enablement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define, build, and drive strategy: develop and lead the enterprise learning and enablement strategy for RBS, ensuring alignment with RRX CI principles and leadership competency models.
  • Modernize content and build new: overhaul and optimize existing RBS training content to enhance instructional effectiveness and business impact; build new content to cover gaps in learning or delivery in alignment with our strategy.
  • Enterprise deployment: ensure consistent and scalable deployment of RBS learning content across all business units in collaboration with the VPs RBS.
  • Data‑driven improvement: establish KPIs and leverage data analytics to continuously improve learning effectiveness and demonstrate ROI and CI maturity.
  • Platform innovation: enhance learning platforms and integrate automation to streamline delivery and improve learner experience.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree Required, Advanced Degree Preferred
  • 10+ years of experience in continuous improvement or learning and organizational development, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role.
  • Demonstrated success in leading enterprise‑wide learning strategies and enablement programs that deliver measurable business results.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with a track record of executing complex, cross‑functional initiatives.
  • Proven change management approach and expertise to drive successful and sustainable transformation at all levels of the organization.
  • Deep expertise in Lean/CI methodologies, with experience in both manufacturing and non‑manufacturing environments as a practitioner and leader.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization.

Travel

~25‑50% travel if remote.

Annual Base Compensation

$155,200 - $241,800

The salary range provided is intended to display the value of the company’s base pay compensation for all statewide locations across the United States. Salary is dependent on a multitude of factors, including but not limited to the physical worksite location, candidate’s skill set, level of experience, education and internal peer compensation comparisons.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without requiring company sponsorship to obtain or keep U.S. work authorization.

  • Spending accounts (HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA)
  • Paid Time Off and Holidays

About Regal Rexnord

Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.

The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.

Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.

title: Sr. Director, Program Portfolio
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Director, Program Portfolio Program Management, Health Programs (HP), is a strategic leader overseeing the implementation of HP’s global health portfolio in 50+ countries. Reporting to the Vice President of HP and serving on the senior management team, the Senior (Sr.) Director manages a team of regional Program Directors responsible for delivering FHI 360’s global and bilateral health projects. This role provides strategic oversight, ensures high-quality outcomes, and supports project teams in meeting implementation goals. The Sr. Director offers guidance to country leadership, promotes accountability, and ensures alignment with FHI 360’s operational standards. They represent HP in corporate discussions, collaborate across internal and external stakeholders, and promote continuous improvement through shared learning and innovation. Partnering with Global Operations and Services (GOS) and Finance, they ensure operational support and fiscal health across projects. Additionally, they strengthen the capabilities of staff, contribute to strategic planning, and position FHI 360 as a thought leader in global health.

RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES

  • Accountable for the successful implementation of projects within HP, ensuring financial and programmatic targets are consistently met and client expectations are exceeded.

  • Acts as the primary liaison with other organizational units, linking country/project teams to regional or global units/resources to ensure efficient program implementation in alignment with donor and corporate requirements.

  • Provides direct line management for the regional portfolio management leads; provides direct line and dotted line management to Country Representatives, Chiefs of Party/Project Directors and/or Project Leads, as relevant.

  • Works closely with global and bilateral project leadership to ensure that project management teams are implementing projects in alignment with approved workplans, technically compliant and within budget. Works with leadership to mitigate any impact on projects when issues arise.

  • Monitors and reports on the financial health of the portfolio, ensuring sound fiscal management. Promptly raises concerns and potential risks to HP leadership.

  • Regularly communicates project status, decisions, risks, issues, and timelines to HP leadership and relevant organization groups.

  • Regularly meets with GOS and Enterprise Services teams to ensure that program implementation teams are receiving the required country-level support required to ensure successful and compliant implementation.

  • Represents HP in corporate-level discussions on operational policies and procedures and flows down changes in process to implementation teams.

  • Navigates complex challenges inherent in project implementation.

  • Offers strategic direction and innovative solutions for portfolio-specific challenges.

  • Collaborates with global project and technical leadership teams to analyzes project performance and identify areas for improvement.

  • Promotes innovation and best practices in project management, offering subject matter expertise to project teams (from junior staff to project leaders) to ensure professional development and skills building.

  • Recommends actionable solutions to enhance effectiveness and efficiency to ensure the portfolio management team is responsive to project leadership.

  • Fosters innovation and shares best practices to drive organizational impact.

  • Contributes to achieving FHI 360 and HP goals.

  • Exercises discretion over project-related matters with direct impact on project outcomes and organizational success.

  • Makes decisions on resource allocation, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.

Collaboration & Interaction

  • Engages with internal and external stakeholders to gather and share evidence, lessons learned, and best practices.

  • Fosters partnerships with project teams, donors, and implementing partners.

  • Facilitates communication and knowledge exchange to enhance project outcomes through a transparent and collaborative approach.

  • Works cross-functionally to achieve common goals and drive organizational impact.

  • Establishes and maintains relationships across FHI 360, including with all HP and Enterprise Support colleagues.

Management & Supervision

  • Oversees a program management team responsible for implementing projects within HP.

  • Provides leadership and guidance to project teams.

  • Sets strategic direction, manages budgets, and ensures programmatic quality.

  • Focuses on fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.

  • Manages project staff through a matrixed management approach and shapes the portfolio structure for optimal efficiency and effectiveness.

  • Demonstrated mentorship skills.

  • Embraces other duties as assigned, contributing to HP’s multifaceted and evolving responsibilities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or its International Equivalent in Business Administration, International Development, Communication, Social Marketing, Economic Development, Education, Health, Nutrition, Research, Technology, Youth, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in project management, overseeing complex projects and initiatives; Experience managing United States Government (USG)-funded projects; focus on HIV, Global Health Security, TB, Maternal, Newborn, Child Health (MNCH) and/or Nutrition projects preferred. Will consider candidates without health related projects experience.

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in a leadership position.

  • Proven experience leading and managing complex, strategic portfolios of programs/projects on a national or international scale.

  • Experience leading teams in complex settings, managing financial and human resources.

  • Significant experience working in non-governmental organizations (NGOs).

  • English language fluency required; fluency in a second language (e.g., Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, Arabic, etc.) an added advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in a related field.

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification or other recognized project management certification.

  • Certifications relevant to organizational leadership.

  • We welcome candidates with other relevant certifications or their international equivalents.

TRAVEL

  • Up to 20% travel may be required for this role, primarily to engage with stakeholders, oversee project implementation, and attend meetings and events related to portfolio activities.

TECHNOLOGY

  • Computer/Laptop, Microsoft applications (Office 365, SharePoint, Skype/Zoom/Teams), cell phone/mobile technology, and standard office equipment.

When determining an offer amount, FHI 360 factors in multiple considerations, including but not limited to: relevant years of experience and education possessed by the applicant, internal equity, business sector, and budget.

Base salary is only one component of our offer. FHI 360 contributes 7 % of monthly base pay to a money purchase pension plan account. Additionally, all US based staff working full-time, which is calculated at 40 hours per week, receive 18 days of paid vacation per year, 12 sick days per year, and 11 holidays per year. Paid time off is reduced pro rata for employees working less than a full-time schedule.

title: Senior Product Manager – Item Data Platform
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Location: LATAM

You’re an original. So are we.

We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path. We invented the blue jean in 1873, and we reinvented khaki pants in 1986. We pioneered labor and environmental guidelines in manufacturing. And we work to build sustainability into everything we do. Our brands stand for freedom and self-expression around the world.

Where we lead, others follow. For more than 160 years, we’ve used the strength of our brands to lead with our values and make an outsized impact on the world. We employ more than 15,000 people globally to support our great brands: Levi’s®, Beyond Yoga®, and Signature by Levi Strauss & Co.™

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Digital Product Creation program. This product manager will support our product creation teams (merchandising, design, product development), the backbone of our business and how we take products from idea to physical creation. You will be responsible for transforming how we manage our Item Data. Sitting at the core platforms of our business, you will be required to work across several business functions, navigate across varying technical architectures and work closely with other Product Managers across the Digital organization to get things done. The ideal candidate should have some experience in building or delivering on data platforms and/or Product Information Management solutions in the past -- any experience in retail & apparel, and internal go-to-market or supply chain processes is a plus.

About the Job

  • Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Item Data platform, ensuring alignment with enterprise PLM and product creation goals. Motivate and inspire stakeholders, other PMs, and the technical team around the vision and champion these benefits throughout the company
  • Define business use cases and processes that will help shape how we define item data domains, core entities, data attributes and definitions and schemas that power automation and efficiencies for product creation, planning, manufacturing, and selling
  • Lead the discovery and documentation of data use cases, data authoring responsibilities, and data lifecycle rules (e.g. survivorship, priority, and versioning) across systems and teams
  • Serve as the product owner for item data governance, ensuring clarity around data ownership, stewardship, and quality standards across the organization
  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to modernize our item data ecosystem and transition to scalable, service-oriented architectures. Navigate and influence an evolving technical landscape, balancing short-term delivery with long-term platform resilience and flexibility
  • Translate complex technical and data architecture concepts into clear priorities, product requirements, and roadmaps that deliver measurable business value and returns on investment
  • Champion the adoption of best practices in domain driven design, data modeling, and metadata management to support evolving business needs
  • Partner with engineering and design to co-develop potential solutions to user needs, exploring both use of third-party offerings and internal development of capabilities. Understand technical complexity of different product initiatives and the balance between quick wins vs platform longevity
  • Where we do leverage 3rd party software, be able to effectively communicate + influence the vendor roadmap to prioritize enhancements or new capabilities. Be willing to make difficult tradeoffs of using the out of the box functionality or customizing the platform based on business needs
  • Manage the full spectrum of the product development process, using prototypes and MVPs (Minimum Viable Products) to test assumptions and refine product directions based on real user engagement
  • Manage a dynamic and evolving product backlog – prioritize new ideas, enhancement requests from users, competitive analysis, and engagement data for your product. Be able to synthesize lots of data sources to know what should, and even more important, should not be prioritized
  • Keep a pulse on the industry. Conduct competitive analysis, evaluate other retailers, and stay informed on the industry and evolving technologies in this space
  • Be able to collect + synthesize data to be data informed and comfortable leading with your recommendations. Use experimentation to take that data, define a hypothesis, and run a test and receive data learn what works and does not work for our fans and our business
  • Support product releases through close partnerships with business and operations teams, understanding ways of working and effectively communicating changes to our business users
  • Establish the right KPIs and analytics strategy to shape insights. Measure and monitor success of KPIs on a daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly basis
  • Be a leader for our product organization. Help transform how we work by identifying new ways of working, implementing and championing those ideas, and mentoring other PMs to level up our organization

About You

  • 6-8 years of experience in product management for complex and technical software products, especially in data platforms
  • Strong data and analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize insights to drive initiatives
  • Proven track record in product discovery and leading teams to achieve ambitious KPIs
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for cross-functional collaboration
  • Nice-to-have: Experience in apparel or go-to-market processes

LOCATION Remote - Mexico

FULL TIME/PART TIME Full time

Current LS&Co Employees, apply via your Workday account.

title: Field Medical Partner
description:
Job Description National Veterinary Associates is one of the largest and most respected communities of veterinary hospitals in the world, operating nearly 1,000 hospitals in North America, including in all 50 states, and caring for 8,000,000+ animals annually. NVA is backed by JAB Holding, a leading private equity firm. Each person who joins NVA is motivated by our mission to provide excellent, accessible care to improve the lives of animals and the people who love them. NVA has been extremely successful over its 25+ year history and we’re very excited about our next chapter as we work toward our shared vision of revolutionizing the pet care experience to provide more fulfilling lives for pets, their companions, and our team.

Are you passionate about driving excellence in veterinary care and supporting the professional growth of veterinary teams? Do you love animals and the people who love them? NVA GP is looking for Field Medical Partner (FMP). This role offers a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the veterinary community.

In this role, you will partner closely with the field leadership team and collaborate deeply with hospital leadership across your assigned division(s) to execute strategic initiatives, promote clinical excellence, and enhance the experience of veterinary professionals. This position plays a pivotal role in aligning operations, finance, and medical priorities to support hospital success and deliver sustainable business results. The primary focus will be advancing standards of care across NVA’s GP community to deliver exceptional outcomes for patients, clients, and teams. This individual will report to the Director of Clinical Strategy and Standards as a key member of the Medical Team, serving as a bridge between field operations and clinical strategy.

If you are an experienced and passionate veterinary leader who shares our commitment to quality care and professional development, we want to hear from you!

What You’ll Be Doing

In this full‑time role, your core responsibilities will center on high‑impact activities within the hospitals designed to elevate medical quality:

  • Collaborate with hospitals to evaluate and improve medical practices, including the development of a quality‑of‑care framework and ensuring consistent implementation of standards. Support hospital teams in aligning with established protocols and best practices.
  • Partner with MDVMs to maintain compliance with provincial veterinary regulations. Conduct compliance audits and work with teams to address gaps and sustain regulatory alignment.
  • Partner with MDVMs and operations teams to apply tailored strategies for hospital success. Participate in regional and national events to foster community engagement.
  • In partnership with the FLT, People and Recruiting Teams, work to develop initiatives to foster a sense of belonging and satisfaction among veterinary professionals.
  • Promote a positive culture and an environment of psychological safety.
  • Elevate the hospital teams through meaningful training and development opportunities.
  • Serve as a thought partner and subject‑matter expert for the Field and Hospital Leadership in support hospital teams in achieving their goals.

What You’ll Bring to NVA GP

  • 10+ years of clinical experience
  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM or VMD) degree from an accredited school
  • Licensed (or eligible for licensure) to practice veterinary medicine in all applicable states for assigned hospitals
  • Proven leadership and management experience
  • Strong understanding of veterinary regulations and standards of care
  • Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and problem‑solving skills
  • Should live in close proximity to a large airport
  • Ability to travel (approximately 50%)

Key Competencies

  • Collaboration: Build strong relationships with hospital teams and partner functions.
  • Proactive Problem‑Solving: Anticipate challenges and develop solutions.
  • Organizational Skills: Effectively manage workflows and prioritize tasks.
  • Commitment to Excellence: Uphold the highest standards in veterinary care

Compensation: $135-165,000 salary with additional incentives and benefits

National Veterinary Associates is a leading global pet care organization united in the love of animals and the people who love them. At NVA, we’re on a mission to improve the lives of pets and the people who love them. That starts by empowering our care teams. We nurture their growth with resources to practice medicine their way. Our network of 1,000 hospitals connects them to a community of professionals who share their passion so they can learn and grow together. Our national presence enables us to deliver technology and innovations that simplify work and expand care for all. At NVA, we're committed to your professional growth. We support your entire career journey, offering opportunities ranging from mentorship to ownership.

NVA offers a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, vision, a 401(k) with employer match, and paid time off (including sick time) for all eligible employees. The team can provide more information about compensation and benefits for your specific location during the process. For positions based in Colorado, NVA provides eligible employees with paid sick and safe leave and public health emergency leave in accordance with the requirements of Colorado’s Healthy Families and Workplaces Act.

NVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.

  • Acompanhar e direcionar as tratativas, inseridas pela equipe, nas planilhas de Pendências de Faturamento e dar suporte na cobrança de casos mais complexos;
  • Fornecer informações relacionadas às Pendências de Faturamento ou outras do Departamento, para fins de auditorias;

  • Tratar os feedbacks recebidos nas pesquisas de satisfação, realizadas com os clientes e elaborar planos de ação, em conjunto com a Gestão e equipe da Qualidade, a fim de promover a solução de problemas e melhoria de avaliação qualitativa do Departamento;

  • Controlar metas, desempenho, programação de férias, absenteísmo e necessidade de substituições, da equipe sob sua hierarquia, a fim de manter o atendimento ao Departamento Comercial, dentro dos parâmetros adequados.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa nas áreas de Administração, Comercial ou Saúde;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento, em Gestão Comercial, Marketing, Gestão Hospitalar ou correlatas;
  • Microsoft Office intermediário a avançado, especialmente Excel;
  • Experiência mínima de 03 anos, no ramo de materiais médicos hospitalares;
  • Experiência com gestão de pequenas equipes;
  • Domínio dos portais de cotação, utilizados no ramo de atuação da empresa;
  • Conhecimento dos processos comerciais, relacionados a licitações;

title: Director Budget Investment
description:
Click on "Learn more about this agency" button below for IMPORTANT additional information.

The primary purpose of this position is to exercise overall staff responsibility for planning, establishing policy for, directing and administering Air Force-wide budget activities across a variety of Air Force appropriations and funds.

Duties

Plans, directs and supervises the budget formulation efforts of the Air Force in the above appropriations, and in this capacity serve as the Air Force Budget Investment focal point. Develops definitive and detailed estimates of financing requirements of numerous program alternatives and combinations of alternatives utilizes in the formulation of the final approved Air Force program. This involves the development of two separate and distinct but compatible budget estimates, i.e., the Air Force budget expressed in appropriation terms and a budget arrayed in the Future Years Defense Program (FYDP) format of the Planning, Programming, Budgeting System (PPBS). Plans and directs the development of definitive estimates for an extended period for the individual weapon and support systems that comprise Program Elements across the FYDP. The Director provides continuous improvement of the financial management systems to insure maximum utilization of available resources and to facilitate the relating of capital investments and other costs to weapon systems, tasks and missions. Plans, directs, and supervises the development of data to aid in the proper assessment of cost and effectiveness of alternate programs. This permits the Department of the Air Force and the Department of Defense management to make crucial decisions as to the major forces and weapon systems required to accomplish the Air Force mission. Plans, directs and coordinates the activities of the Directorate in ensuring effective utilization of available resources and correlating investment costs to procured weapon systems, MILCON, MFH, BRAC, and FMs; evaluating budget execution performance and identifying key programmatic and funding issues; participating with the Air Staff in formulation of composite policies and objectives in achieving the best balance between dollar availability among multi-year appropriations and scope of program; assuring consistency of policies between the diversified appropriation and budget activities; developing data to aid in the assessment of cost and effectiveness of alternate programs. Plans, directs and coordinates the activities of the Directorate in the Air Force's Enhanced Corporate Structure to achieve and maintain the proper balance between program levels and available financing. Incumbent will serve as Chairperson of the Investment Budget Review Committee (IBRC), which conducts an in-depth analysis of all investment programs. Presents recommendations to the Air Force Board to best realign investment resources and defend those resources based on the IBRC analysis of budget execution and/or program executability. Plans, directs and supervises the preparation and submission of authorization requests and budget estimates to the Office, Secretary of Defense (OSD), Office of Management and Budget (0MB), Armed Services and Appropriations Committees of the Congress; the preparation of justification material for support of these annual authorizations and budget estimates; and the preparation of material for inclusion of the President's Annual Budget Message to Congress. Plans, directs, supervises and coordinates the presentation and defense of authorization and directs and supervises the execution of the budget in such a manner as to improve the stature and standards of the Air Force through the effective expenditure of these multi-billion dollar appropriations. Directs and supervises the review of the USAF policies and objectives pertaining to the various appropriations to assure consistency and conformance to the Air Force objectives, and to achieve and maintain the proper balance between program level and available financing. Establishes broad guidance and supervises the development of apportionment requests and backup material in defense thereof to obtain release of funds appropriated by Congress, and for the defense of these requests before OSD and 0MB. The Director supervises the control and distribution of appropriated and apportioned funds to appropriate commands, operating agencies, and PEO's and the administration of these appropriations to insure conformance with legal requirements. Directs continuing efforts to improve the accuracy and creditability of estimates and the management of all resources; directs a continuing evaluation of the use and relationship of resources required for various program elements in terms of need and time. This involves field visits, meetings and conferences with the major operating commands and other agencies, as well as advising and guiding Air Staff efforts along these lines. Directs and supervises financial management of Security Assistance Activities (SAA) which includes policy and procedures, budgeting, International Cooperative Programs and Non-recurring Cost Recoupment.

Requirements

  • U.S. citizenship is required
  • Males must be registered for Selective Service, see
  • Disclosure of Political Appointments
  • Mobility is a condition of employment and appointment for SES members will be required to sign a Reassignment Rights and Obligations Agreement
  • Selected candidate must file an Executive Personnel Financial Disclosure Report (OGE Form 278) in accordance with the Ethics in Government Act of 1978
  • Position has been designated Critical-Sensitive and the selectee must have or be able to obtain a Top Secret clearance
  • Drug testing designated position. The incumbent is subject to random testing for drug use IAW Exec. Order 12564, dated 14 Sep 86. Position requires that the incumbent sign a Drug Testing letter and pass urinalysis testing prior to appointment.
  • Position requires travel under conditions specified in the DoD Joint Travel Regulations. Incumbent is expected to travel on short notice to attend high-level meetings.
  • Position may require incumbent to be available for other than normal duty hours to include weekends to support exercises and crisis planning.
  • An initial SES career appointment becomes final only after the individual successfully completes a 1-year probationary period.
  • Attendance to the Air Force's Senior Leader Orientation Course (SLOC) is generally required within 12 months of appointment, subject to course availability.
  • Position may be subject to the post-government employment restrictions of Sections 207(a) and (f) of Title 18, United States Code.
  • Applicants in receipt of an annuity based on civilian employment in the Federal Service are subject to the DoD Policy on The Employment of Annuitants.

title: YouTube Manager
description:
A Impact Media is on a mission to empower real estate professionals to own their market through media.

At A Impact Media, we don't just hire for open roles, we hire for impact. If you're exceptional at what you do and align with our core values: beyond excellence, extreme ownership, proactive curiosity, and mission focused, we want to know you.

When you apply, please make sure the subject line is: "I actually read the instructions".

Role

We are hiring a YouTube Manager for A Impact Media.

The YouTube Manager is a strategic and creative leader who serves as the connective tissue between our clients' business priorities and how they're translated to long-form videos.

You're not just managing YouTube channels. You're building the top real estate channels across the country, making clients locally famous, and setting a bar for content so high others can only chase. You'll own the strategy, the story, and the systems behind uploads that scale our clients' local authority to hundreds of thousands of impressions a year on YouTube.

This isn't your typical content role. You're a multifaceted creative, fluent in ideation, production planning, compelling copywriting, post-production oversight, and YouTube analytics.

Your curiosity for real estate fundamentals matches your passion for dominating YouTube's local market landscape. You're fired up about crafting standout content that transforms the way top agents and teams will approach media and market dominance.

You'll lead the production, posting, and packaging direction of our videos, distill key insights into engaging content, and ensure continuous improvement through rigorous analysis and feedback loops. You'll also maintain strategic alignment with key business initiatives.

You’ll work hand-in-hand with our YouTube Strategists/Client Success Manager, creative team, and client teams to shape channel strategy, content production, and distribution.

If the idea of leading and growing YouTube's top real estate channels excites you, let's talk.

Team Leadership and YouTube Infrastructure

  • Manage editors, thumbnail designers, and pre‑production team across multiple client accounts
  • Support relevant YouTube scorecard metrics (CTR, retention, view velocity, follower growth) and present insights to leadership and clients
  • Support scalable, documented systems for scripting, packaging, and production handoffs
  • Grow and develop direct reports and members of the YouTube Team
  • Explore and test AI tools to accelerate pre‑ and post‑production workflows. Identify opportunities to prototype AI‑driven content testing, retention analysis, and scripting support
  • Coordinate with marketing, shorts teams, and external stakeholders for distribution and promotion

YouTube Strategy and Channel Architecture

  • Support YouTube channel growth strategy with input from clients
  • Balance evergreen local content with timely reactions to market trends and other experimental formats
  • Ensure every video not only educates but reinforces the authority, credibility, and mission of our clients. Maintain each brand's distinct tone while ensuring consistency
  • Support the visual identity of packaging and run consistent A/B testing for packaging on back catalogue
  • Keep relevant YouTube scorecard metrics and present weekly insights to team and clients

Pre‑Production

  • Support ideation and outlier research sessions
  • Provide feedback and insight to YouTube team members on packaging briefs and video outlines
  • Maintain a four‑to‑six‑week buffer of fully approved topics (outlines, rough thumbnail concepts and title options)

Post‑Production

  • Ownership and management over post‑production timelines and upload calendar
  • Conduct regular retention reviews to improve audience engagement
  • Work with Senior Editor to provide retention notes on edits + final approval for uploads
  • Create brand guidelines, SOPs, and artifacts to continuously make post‑production seamless and cohesive

Results

  • Support 45‑60+ videos consistently delivered monthly within your team, you'll specifically only manage around 5‑10 clients
  • 90%+ on‑time delivery rate
  • Client channels achieving 100‑1000 subscriber growth monthly
  • Support of client revenue goals (generating leads monthly and $7.5‑10M+ in sales a year per client)
  • 50‑75% of videos that outperform channel baselines on impressions and subscriber growth
  • Lift in subscriber‑to‑view ratios for videos
  • Higher average views per video and a steeper 24/48‑hour velocity curve
  • Regular documentation of content experiments and A/B tests
  • Improved usage of AI and other tools to increase team leverage in production
  • Client sentiment on brand and growth (excitement about filming, video topics, performance and brand discussions)

Requirements

  • Understanding of the YouTube landscape – concepts, thumbnails, titles, and retention editing
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical fundamentals and ability to work with data
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in YouTube channel development, bonus points if for a large educational channel
  • Proficiency with editing notes tools (like Frame.io)
  • Proficiency with project management tools like Notion
  • Proficiency with GSuite
  • Knowledge of editing and Photoshop considered an asset but not essential

Communication Expectations

  • We use Slack as the go‑to for any communications
  • We value over‑communication (more context the better)
  • We value speed in communication (be prompt in responding or provide context as to why you may be slow to respond)
  • Weekly Creative Team Meetings
  • Weekly meetings with Media Manager/Team Leader
  • Weekly meetings with creative team

Location

Remote (work from home)

Hours

Mon - Fri 9am - 6pm EST with flexibility to work weekends when needed.

Compensation

$16,800 - $28,800 USD annually with progression from part‑time to full‑time. Highly experienced YouTube strategists can earn $24,000 to $36,000 USD a year.

Benefits

  • 30‑60 day paid trial period
  • Flexible work arrangements (part‑time to full‑time path)
  • Remote work flexibility
  • Performance‑based advancement opportunities

Core Values

  • Beyond Excellence – We raise the bar, then we raise it again. Good enough is not good enough. We find joy in the pursuit of mastery and believe excellence is a moving target.
  • Extreme Ownership – Own the outcome. Take full responsibility for results. Say "I will" instead of "they should." Measure yourself by your clients' success.
  • Proactive Curiosity – Curious minds build better things. Question everything. Connect ideas others miss. Ask "What if?" and "Why not?" See challenges as opportunities to learn.
  • Mission Focused – Small things build big things. Align personal purpose with professional pursuit. Find fulfillment in the work itself. Believe that helping others succeed is the highest calling.

Application Process

To apply: If you're interested, please submit the following:

  • A link to your resume in PDF format with the following naming convention: (Lastname.Firstname.YouTube‑Manager.pdf)
  • Links to YouTube channels you've managed and their growth metrics (or your portfolio)
  • Send a link to your completed personality quiz:
  • Your answer to this question: What's the most innovative YouTube strategy you've implemented and what were the results?
  • Your answer to this question: What does this quote mean to you personally? "Work is love made visible" - Khalil Gibran

Submissions should go to:

I will be looking for people who can format their submission in a way that makes it easy for us to review. Remember, in production management you want to help make processes as efficient as possible! I'm happy to answer any questions you may include in your application.

Thank you for your consideration and best of luck on your job search!

description:
We’re looking for talented professionals, anywhere in the United States, to join us in bringing smart money management and payment solutions to everyone’s fingertips.

At Green Dot, we are evolving to a new and permanent “Work from Anywhere” model designed to maximize the benefits of remote work, promote and enable a strong culture of performance and connectedness, and attract the best and brightest talent who align with our entrepreneurial spirit and mission.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The BSA/AML Operations Lead Analyst is responsible for overseeing the strategic and day-to-day execution of BSA/AML/OFAC compliance operations. This role combines deep analytical expertise with operational leadership to drive improvements in transaction monitoring, partner/product risk assessments, and capacity planning. The ideal candidate will be a creative thinker with strong investigative instincts, technical fluency, and a passion for building scalable, compliant processes in a dynamic financial services environment.

Key Responsibilities

Transaction Monitoring & Rule Tuning

  • Analyze large, complex datasets from transaction monitoring systems to identify patterns, improve alert productivity, and enhance detection accuracy.
  • Lead rule tuning initiatives and collaborate with analytics, engineering, and compliance teams to optimize monitoring logic.
  • Recommend enhancements to existing reporting processes to better capture unusual activity.

Partner & Product Risk Assessment

  • Conduct impact assessments for new partners and products, ensuring AML controls are appropriately tailored and implemented.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for assigned products and partnerships, overseeing their compliance posture.
  • Collaborate with product and business teams to ensure operational readiness and risk mitigation strategies are in place.

Capacity Planning & Operational Oversight

  • Forecast alert volumes and staffing needs based on rule changes, product launches, and seasonal trends.
  • Oversee onshore and offshore teams to ensure SLA adherence for SARs, CTRs, OFAC screening, and other regulatory filings.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline, automate, or outsource operational processes.

Investigations & Reporting

  • Lead investigations into suspicious activity, linking related behaviors and uncovering emerging fraud and money laundering trends.
  • Oversee SAR filing processes and ensure compliance with all BSA/AML/OFAC regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain documentation standards and ensure readiness for audits and regulatory exams.

Training & Leadership

  • Mentor BSA/AML analysts, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate training sessions for new hires and cross-functional partners.
  • Partner with senior management to develop and implement policies and controls aligned with evolving threats.

Compliance Requirement

All employees in this role are required to complete and maintain current training in Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) regulations. This includes initial onboarding training and ongoing annual refreshers, as mandated by Green Dot’s compliance policies. Non-compliance could pose reputational, legal, and financial risks to the organization.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in BSA/AML/OFAC operations, preferably in fintech or money transfer environments.
  • Proven experience in financial crime investigations and transaction monitoring.
  • Strong analytical skills; proficiency in Excel.
  • Excellent communication skills across all mediums.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and professional.

Preferred

  • Prior supervisory or team leadership experience.
  • SQL preferred.
  • CAMS or CFE certification a plus.

POSITION TYPE

Regular

PAY RANGE

The targeted base salary for this position is $91,100 to $136,700 per year. The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.

We’re Here to Support You—Accommodations Upon Request

Green Dot is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, we encourage you to let us know. We will work with you to meet your needs in a way that respects your privacy and ensures equal opportunity. Our goal is to support every applicant in showcasing their talents and potential.

Work Authorization Requirement

At Green Dot Corporation, we value diversity and strive for fair and inclusive hiring practices. However, we are currently unable to offer visa sponsorship. title: Ux Designer
description:
Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features. At Memory Ware, we craft games that invite players into deep, meaningful experiences with systems that reward curiosity and stories that linger long after the screen fades.

We’re looking for a UX Designer who is excited to shape player experience across combat, exploration, and narrative, especially in games inspired by classic and modern JRPGs.

As a UX Designer on our team, you’ll own UX initiatives across the entire player journey, from moment-to-moment interactions to broader systemic experiences like progression, combat, and exploration.

We’re not just looking for someone to make interfaces clean and usable; we want someone who can envision how each interaction, mechanic, and layer of feedback contributes to an unforgettable player experience.

You’ll collaborate closely with game designers, engineers, UI artists, and narrative designers to ensure the whole game feels cohesive, intuitive, and emotionally resonant.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring that core mechanics (e.g., combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) feel intuitive, satisfying, and player‑first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the entire gameplay loop and propose smart, game‑genre‑aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure that visual and technical execution supports both usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro, and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low‑fidelity prototypes to help build confidence on our systems.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying both good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • Portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine (ideally Unity).
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player‑first mindset: you design with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to explain your reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system‑heavy or narrative‑rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience designing for console or controller‑first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy, especially if you can engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

To Apply

Email us your resume and portfolio and feel free to include any details about yourself that you’d like to share. Send your e‑mail to “******” with a subject like “UX Designer – Your Name”.

About Memory Ware

Memory Ware is a fully remote studio, born on **** to sustainably create video games designed with a player‑first philosophy, crafting compelling stories and experiences that create lasting, core memories for players. We are a self‑funded studio in the early stages of development on a new JRPG project.

If you’re eager to help create a healthy and fun work environment alongside a highly experienced team, you’ll feel right at home with us.

ABOUT COMMERCIAL BANK

The Commercial Bank, now inclusive of Payments, is the heart of KeyBank’s business segment and is targeted for rapid growth. Comprised of commercial client relationship teams, commercial risk, onboarding and servicing, Institutional Bank payments business development and payments products and solutions. The Commercial Bank caters to a wide breadth of industry verticals and client segments, and our portfolio of solutions is positioned to support commercial entities of all sizes - from a mom-and-pop restaurant, to a publicly traded company.

We are seeking a Commercial Instructional Design Lead, AI Enablemen t, in Learning Enablement within Commercialization servicing Commercial Bank. The Instructional Designer will ensure our AI strategies are embraced across the enterprise and deliver measurable impact. This role will lead the charge in driving organizational readiness, building AI literacy, and enabling business teams to integrate AI into their workflows — ultimately bridging the gap between capability investment and business value.

Essential Job Functions

  • As part of the AI squad will partner with the Commercial Bank AI team to define and execute commercialization strategies for AI solutions.

  • Champion responsible AI practices and foster a culture of innovation and experimentation.
  • Act as a strategic liaison between technical teams and business units to ensure clarity, alignment, and readiness.
  • Communicate complex AI concepts in accessible language tailored to different stakeholder groups.
  • Promote success stories and share learnings to build momentum and confidence in AI initiatives.
  • Continuously activate the organization in AI usage and enablement.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in instructional design, enablement, product commercialization, digital transformation, or organizational change roles.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders at all levels.

Preferred Skills

  • 3+ years experience in instructional design, adult learning, or organizational development.

  • Familiarity with AI governance and responsible AI principles.
  • Background in instructional design, adult learning, or organizational development.
  • Data-driven mindset with ability to measure and report on adoption and impact.

Physical Demands

Validating and project managing new business opportunities that support long‑term strategic expansion. description:
We are seeking highly analytical and detail-oriented professionals with hands-on experience in Red Teaming, Prompt Evaluation, and AI/LLM Quality Assurance.

The ideal candidate will help us rigorously test and evaluate AI-generated content to identify vulnerabilities, assess risks, and ensure compliance with safety, ethical, and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct Red Teaming exercises to identify adversarial, harmful, or unsafe outputs from large language models (LLMs).
  • Evaluate and stress-test AI prompts across multiple domains (e.g., finance, healthcare, security) to uncover potential failure modes.
  • Develop and apply test cases to assess accuracy, bias, toxicity, hallucinations, and misuse potential in AI-generated responses.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, safety researchers, and prompt engineers to report risks and suggest mitigations.
  • Perform manual QA and content validation across model versions, ensuring factual consistency, coherence, and guideline adherence.
  • Create evaluation frameworks and scoring rubrics for prompt performance and safety compliance.
  • Document findings, edge cases, and vulnerability reports with high clarity and structure.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in AI red teaming, LLM safety testing, or adversarial prompt design.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, NLP tasks, and ethical considerations in generative AI.
  • Strong background in Quality Assurance, content review, or test case development for AI/ML systems.
  • Understanding of LLM behaviors, failure modes, and model evaluation metrics.
  • Excellent critical thinking, pattern recognition, and analytical writing skills.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed evaluation protocols, and meet tight deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior work with teams like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, or other LLM safety initiatives.
  • Experience in risk assessment, red team security testing, or AI policy & governance.
  • Background in linguistics, psychology, or computational ethics is a plus.

Next Steps

Link: Versant English Proficiency Test focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency. A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify.

title: Ux Designer
description:
About Memory Ware

Memory Ware is a fully remote studio, born to sustainably create video games designed with a player‑first philosophy, crafting compelling stories and experiences that create lasting, core memories for players.

We are a self‑funded studio in the early stages of development on a new JRPG project. If you're eager to help create a healthy and fun work environment alongside a highly experienced team, you'll feel right at home with us.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead UX thinking across major systems, ensuring that core mechanics (e.g. combat, dungeons, item use, turn management) feel intuitive, satisfying, and player‑first.
  • Design flows, wireframes, and interaction prototypes to support key experiences, not just interfaces.
  • Collaborate with designers to improve the feel and clarity of core game mechanics.
  • Identify friction points across the entire gameplay loop and propose smart, genre‑aware solutions.
  • Bridge the Design Team with other teams to ensure that visual and technical execution supports both usability and emotional tone.
  • Use tools like Figma, Miro and Unity to develop and communicate UX intent and build low‑fidelity prototypes to build confidence on our systems.
  • Research and document genre conventions (especially JRPGs), identifying good practices and opportunities for innovation.
  • Help define usability testing plans and translate feedback into actionable iterations.
  • Advocate for accessibility, clarity, and joy in every part of the game.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience as a senior or lead UI/UX designer on at least one shipped game or app.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, user flows, and UX strategy.
  • Experience working directly with engineers and shipping UI in a game engine (ideally Unity).
  • Experience designing UX in game development, ideally on games with layered systems and mechanics.
  • A player‑first mindset: design with emotional clarity, pacing, and flow in mind.
  • Strong UX fundamentals: flow design, interaction principles, usability best practices.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to explain reasoning, take feedback, and build alignment.
  • Comfort owning initiatives and proactively improving player experience across disciplines.
  • Passion for system‑heavy or narrative‑rich games, especially RPGs, strategy, or adventure titles.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience designing for console or controller‑first games.
  • Motion design or interaction design skills for feedback and transitions.
  • Game design literacy and ability to engage in design discussions beyond UX.
  • Familiarity with accessibility design for games.

To Apply

Send your e‑mail to ****** with a subject line like ’UX Designer – Your Name’. Please include your resume and portfolio, and feel free to share any additional details about yourself.

Our Culture

  • We have hubs in the Bay Area, NYC, Austin, and Toronto. However, we maintain a remote-first work culture. #WorkFromAnywhere
  • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.
  • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

About The Role

We're a growing company looking for a Product Designer to join our team and help us design a user-centric SaaS dashboard to prevent fraud.

This isn't just about pixels; it's about problem-solving. You'll work closely with other designers, product managers, and engineers to understand complex challenges and create intuitive and comprehensive experiences for our users. We have a complex product; you will need to make it easy.

As a fast-growing start-up, you will need to independently explore the context, talk to different stakeholders, understand the problem end-to-end, and propose solutions that make sense with our product.

Requests usually come with just the tip of the iceberg. You will need to get into the bushes. This role is not for a Product Designer that expects a complete brief, a list of detailed tasks, and endless calls. We move fast. You need to be fast. And good.

  • Proactively drive the entire design process, from independently identifying user problems and exploring solutions through research and validation, to final implementation and hand-off.
  • Go beyond the "happy path" by designing for all user flows, edge cases, and UI states to ensure a smooth hand-off to engineering.
  • We are remote, you need to show visibility, communicate status, and progress reports with your team. Comment, annotate, and tag teammates in all your files. Work closely with product managers and engineers.

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of experience (or strong portfolio) designing UI and UX for dashboards and SaaS products.

  • Master Design Systems and their application to create and scale a consistent dashboard experience.
  • User-centered design principles with a strong understanding of data visualization best practices.
  • Experience communicating with leadership. You will communicate ideas and ping pong requirements with the CEO, CTO, and CPO levels.
  • Be aware of the future state of design. AI is changing the game. We are already exploring new design workflows.
  • Startup / Small Company / Founder Experience.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working in globally distributed teams.

  • Played around with Figma Make, Gemini, Loveable, v0, or similar? Sweet!

Base pay range of R$265,000- R$370,000 BRL + Series C equity with tremendous upside potential + Attractive benefits.

Estamos em busca de pessoas fascinadas por criar um futuro melhor, que sejam inquietas, tenham coragem para desafiar o comum, que valorizem a diversidade de ideias e acreditem no potencial transformador da colaboração verdadeira.

Sabemos que muitas pessoas — especialmente mulheres — só se candidatam a uma vaga se sentem que cumprem 100% dos requisitos. Se esse for o seu caso, queremos te encorajar a se inscrever mesmo assim. Aqui, valorizamos trajetórias diversas e aprendizados ao longo da jornada.

Junte-se a nós na busca por um mundo com novas inteligências.

Na Kunumi, o design é a forma como traduzimos complexidade em sentido. Ele nos ajuda a ver (e fazer os outros verem) aquilo que ainda está sendo imaginado.

Procuramos uma pessoa que compreenda o design não apenas como forma ou estética, mas como uma maneira de pensar, comunicar e provocar. Alguém capaz de transformar conceitos abstratos, dados e ideias em narrativas visuais que inspirem entendimento e emoção , revelando o que há de mais humano na tecnologia que criamos.

Este papel é essencial para dar corpo, cor e ritmo às histórias que contamos sobre quem somos e o impacto que queremos gerar.

Do design gráfico ao digital, da apresentação à visualização de dados, o trabalho dessa pessoa tocará diretamente a forma como a Kunumi se expressa, para dentro e para fora.

Na prática, este papel envolve:

Traduzir ideias complexas em expressões visuais claras, inspiradoras e consistentes com a identidade da Kunumi .

Criar apresentações estratégicas e narrativas visuais que unam estética, clareza e propósito.

Produzir materiais gráficos e digitais para diferentes contextos (internos e externos), com foco em storytelling.

Desenvolver infográficos, visualizações de dados e motion graphics , conectando informação, design e emoção.

Garantir coerência e evolução contínua da identidade visual , cuidando de como ela se manifesta em cada ponto de contato.

Colaborar com áreas diversas (Design, Comunicação, Produto, Liderança) para construir narrativas visuais que reforcem a visão e a cultura Kunumi.

O que é esperado de você

Experiência sólida em design gráfico, visual design e design para apresentações, infografia e storytelling.

Domínio técnico em Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, Google Suíte, principalmente plataformas de apresentação como Google Slides, PowerPoint, Keynote, etc.

Habilidade em utilizar IA generativa para criar imagens e conteúdos.

Autonomia e senso de responsabilidade para conduzir projetos de ponta a ponta, com alta qualidade e atenção a prazos.

Capacidade de síntese e pensamento visual, transformar conceitos complexos em mensagens visuais claras.

Curiosidade e repertório estético, com olhar apurado para composição, tipografia, ritmo e cor.

Boa comunicação e colaboração com pessoas de diferentes áreas e formações.

Capacidade de equilibrar criação e execução, saber quando ousar e quando simplificar.

O que é considerado um diferencial

title: Study Manager (Medical Devices) - FSP
description:
Job Summary

The Study Manager is part of the (DMTI - Digital Medicine and Translational Imaging ) group, that looks to develop and implement novel technologies to support company’s portfolio studies. In particular for this role, Digital Medicine focuses on the deployment of digital health technologies (DHTs) to objectively, remotely, and continuously assess a patient over time using novel digital endpoints.

Job Responsibilities

The DMTI Study Manager would be critical in ensuring the digital medicine data collected across multiple studies is of the highest quality. To facilitate this will require reviewing and monitoring multiple dashboards to discern if data is being collected as expected, and if there are any necessary actions or issues for follow-up. Some examples include: confirming whether the participant is in an ‘active wear’ period based on the protocol (ie, when they should be wearing the device), and if so, whether they are wearing it compliantly (based on pre-specified criteria), if data is being transmitted as expected, and if the battery/memory capacity of the device meets operational requirements.

Additional activities would include reviews of participant and site guides, attending meetings with vendors and study staff to ensure sites have appropriate materials for start-up and conduct, to surface or discuss any troubleshooting or site-based issues related to the digital medicine portion of the study, and to conduct any pertinent participant follow-ups.

In operating across multiple DMTI studies, the DMTI Study Manager will be key in identifying opportunities and trends to better enhance the standardization and efficiency of operational activities associated with these assessments. Examples include: collating list of lessons learned, frequently asked questions, and any study specific exceptions.

Qualifications & Prior Experience

  • Working knowledge of Good Clinical Practices, monitoring, clinical and regulatory operations
  • A scientific or technical degree is preferred along with extensive knowledge of clinical trial methodology
  • BA/BS 7+ years of relevant experience
  • MBA/MS/ 6+ years of relevant experience
  • English is required.
  • Demonstrated clinical research experience and/or study management experience
  • Demonstrated study management/leadership experience
  • Demonstrated oversight of vendors
  • Demonstrated experience in medical devices.

description:

What You Will Do

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Manager of Collaboration to lead our team and oversee our collaboration tools and technologies. This role is not just about maintaining our existing systems; it's about defining what "best-in-class" collaboration looks like for our organization and driving us toward that vision. You will lead our internal team of collaboration engineers and oversee our third-party support provider. Your role is to manage this vendor relationship, ensuring they meet our high standards for service delivery and user satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Strategy and Leadership: Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for our collaboration technology stack, aligning with business goals and future growth. Lead, mentor, and manage a team of internal collaboration engineers and specialists. Stay current with emerging trends and technologies in the collaboration space, evaluating and recommending new solutions.
  • Defining and Delivering Best-in-Class Collaboration: Act as the primary champion for a "best-in-class" collaboration strategy, focusing on user experience, security, and productivity. Develop and implement governance policies and a "right tool for the job" framework to guide employees on when to use email, instant messaging, or video conferencing. Proactively identify and implement features within our existing tools (Google Workspace, Zoom, MS Exchange) to maximize their value and enhance team efficiency. Foster a culture of effective communication and collaboration, working with stakeholders to optimize workflows and reduce communication overload.
  • Vendor and Service Delivery Management: Serve as the primary point of contact and accountability for our outsourced support provider. Define, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) to ensure the vendor meets performance targets. Conduct regular business reviews with the vendor to assess performance, identify areas for improvement, and ensure alignment with our strategic goals. Act as the escalation point for major issues and work closely with the vendor to ensure timely and effective resolution.
  • Security & Governance: Partner with our internal security team to manage and enforce security policies across all collaboration platforms. Oversee email security, data governance, and user access controls to protect sensitive information.
  • Platform Management: Administer and manage our Google Workspace environment, including Gmail, Calendar, Drive, and Meet. Oversee the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of our Zoom platform for meetings, webinars, and room systems. Manage and support our on-premises Microsoft Exchange servers, ensuring high availability and seamless integration with other systems. Maintain and support our conference room technologies, including Logitech kits, Chromeboxes, and Q-Sys audio/video solutions.
  • User Experience and Training: Develop and deliver training programs and documentation to empower users to effectively use collaboration tools. Gather user feedback to identify areas for improvement and work with the outsourced provider to address gaps and drive a better user experience.
  • Project Management: Lead collaboration-related projects, from initial planning and requirements gathering to implementation and post-deployment support. Manage budgets and resources for the collaboration team and related projects.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Strong knowledge of Google Workspace administration and management.
  • 5+ years of experience in managing collaboration technologies in an enterprise environment.
  • Proven experience in vendor management , including negotiating contracts and managing service delivery.
  • Strong knowledge of Zoom administration, including Zoom Rooms and API integrations.
  • Experience with Microsoft Exchange Server administration and hybrid environments.
  • Solid understanding of conference room technologies, including A/V systems, video conferencing hardware (Logitech, Chromeboxes ), and audio processing platforms (Q-Sys).
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Google Workspace Administrator, Zoom Certified Professional) are a plus.

What You Will Need

Education:

  • High School diploma equivalency with 3 years of cumulative experience OR Associate'sdegree/Bachelor's degree with 2 years of cumulative experience OR 7 years of applicable cumulative job specific experience required.
  • 3 years of leadership or management experience preferred.

Additional Preferences

No additional preferences.
